name: m4-symfinal-symops-jit
description: Why does `SymbolOpsBenchmark`'s `all` workload vary by 3.5–4.7% between forks of identical code in `m4-symfinal-symops`, when a fork's iterations stay within about ±8 ms? The hypothesis is that each fork's C2 decisions, made during the single setup compile, persist for the whole fork. `jitRecording` over each fork, with an A/A, so `jit_diff` shows which decisions differ between forks of the same code and the scores show whether they matter.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, no profiler. Recording may change the scores, so compare them only within this campaign.

variantDescriptions.aa: the same commit as `base`, for fork-to-fork differences
